verdict.rationale: Belvo documents a "get started in 10 minutes" flow that sets you up with API keys, a Postman collection, and a simple API walkthrough. It also offers a sandbox for testing the full API, and community members confirm self-serve signup and a ready-made Postman collection. However, no client libraries or SDKs appear anywhere in the evidence, and one hands-on report describes a confusing signup error that slowed onboarding. missing for 10: evidence of official client libraries/SDKs in multiple languages, explicit documentation of creating a first sandbox link end-to-end, smooth signup corroboration
